item.title: Demo Environment
item.description:
Haltian provides a public demo environment with live sensor data from the Haltian office in Oulu, Finland. Use these credentials to explore the platform, test API queries, and build proof-of-concept integrations before deploying your own organization.

Public credentials

These credentials are shared publicly. Do not store sensitive data in the demo organization — it is periodically reset.

Demo Organization

Property Value
Organization haltiansalesdemo
Environment EU

Application Access

Use the following credentials to log in to Haltian IoT Studio (web or mobile) and the Service API (GraphQL).

item.title: Glossary
item.description:
A

Alpha

A pre-release stage where a feature is under active development and available for limited external use. Alpha features may be incomplete or unstable, and are typically accessible via API only with no or minimal application UI. Intended for early testing and feedback to validate core design. Not recommended for production workloads. API surface may change significantly between releases.

API

Application Programming Interface - A set of protocols and tools for building software applications. Haltian IoT provides GraphQL and MQTT APIs.
